title: Subsets

solutions.better:
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def subsets(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]:
        result = []
        path = []

        def dfs(i: int) -> None:
            if i == len(nums):
                result.append(path.copy())
                return
            dfs(i + 1)              # Skip nums[i].
            path.append(nums[i])
            dfs(i + 1)              # Take nums[i].
            path.pop()

        dfs(0)
        return result
